anchors.statement: Each PORT-010 finding in sc-lint#786 must be resolved by shape classification: legitimate platform adapter or helper shapes stop being reported, and real cross-platform parity gaps are still reported.
anchors.quote: these are the p1 items from atm-core: - randlee/sc-lint#786 (PORT-010): all 18 excluded atm-core paths still emit 1–17 findings on 0.8.2, so I removed no exclusions. sc-lint.toml cites it with a release-based removal condition. This is the one that keeps atm-core exclusions in place.
anchors.context: Phase M planning session; atm-core P1 list pasted by Rand; acceptance text from sc-lint#786 'Requested outcome' at atm-core d70ff224
anchors.summary: A1 #786: PORT-010 per-shape classification of the 18 atm-core paths
anchors.scope: The item changes PORT-010 in crates/sc-lint-portability, adds or edits port010 fixtures, edits PORT-010 docs, or changes how atm-core PORT-010 exclusions or platform_adapters are handled.
anchors.deterministic_check: One regression fixture per classified shape under crates/sc-lint-portability/tests/fixtures/port010/ with both an exempt and a real-gap case; the #786 per-path repro (remove one exclude, run sc-lint --json lint sc-portability) on atm-core d70ff224 reports only shapes classified as real gaps.

pass: Adds one port010 fixture per classified #786 shape; the exempt adapter cases report nothing and the real-gap cases still report PORT-010.
fail: Adds the 18 atm-core paths to a default PORT-010 exclusion list so the #786 repro reports nothing.

history.previous_statement: Each PORT-010 diagnostic listed in sc-lint#786 must be resolved by classifying its shape: PORT-010 must stop reporting a shape classified as a legitimate platform adapter or helper, and must keep reporting a shape classified as a real cross-platform parity gap.

anchors.statement: PORT-010 must give a crate-root #[cfg(unix)] fn with a #[cfg(not(unix))] sibling in the same file one documented classification, pinned by a fixture of atm-core's crates/atm/src/main.rs shape.
anchors.quote: these are the p1 items from atm-core: - randlee/sc-lint#720 (PORT-010): a crate-root cfg(unix) fn with a cfg(not(unix)) sibling is still reported. It covers only main.rs.
anchors.context: Phase M planning session; atm-core P1 list pasted by Rand; acceptance criteria from sc-lint#720
anchors.scope: The item changes PORT-010 sibling/companion detection, edits the port010 crate_root_main fixture or port010_fixture_crate_root_main_current_behaviour, or edits PORT-010 docs.
anchors.deterministic_check: port010_fixture_crate_root_main_current_behaviour (crates/sc-lint-portability/tests/fixtures/port010/crate_root_main) is replaced by a test pinning the decided classification, a real-gap variant still reports, and the PORT-010 docs diff states the classification.

pass: Replaces port010_fixture_crate_root_main_current_behaviour with a test pinning the decided classification and documents it in the PORT-010 docs.
fail: Stops reporting the crate-root main.rs shape with no fixture change and no PORT-010 docs update.

history.previous_statement: PORT-010 must apply one decided, documented classification to a crate-root #[cfg(unix)] function that has a #[cfg(not(unix))] sibling in the same file, and a regression fixture of the atm-core crates/atm/src/main.rs shape must pin that classification.

anchors.statement: The [tool.sc-lint] consumer config must accept setup.pre, an argv list that just setup runs before sc-lint provisioning.
anchors.quote: these are the p1 items from atm-core: - randlee/sc-lint#198 (consumer setup hook and step runner): atm-core keeps _py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix and _sc-lint-clippy until it ships.
anchors.context: Phase M planning session; atm-core P1 list pasted by Rand; proposal text from sc-lint#198. CONFLICT: ADR-020 decisions 9 and 13 (Accepted, Rand 2026-10-27) say setup.pre is not added and root-level setup is rejected with config.unknown_table
anchors.summary: A3 #198: consumer setup.pre hook (CONDITIONAL on a new ADR superseding ADR-020 decisions 9/13 and REQ-CLI-021 (clint drafting, Rand approving).)
anchors.scope: The item edits ScLintConfigFile or consumer config parsing in crates/sc-lint (config.rs), the just setup / installer flow, config.unknown_table handling, or ADR-016/ADR-020 hook decisions.
anchors.deterministic_check: A config-parse test accepts setup.pre; a setup test with a stub command records that it ran before provisioning; ADR-020 decisions 9 and 13 are amended.

pass: Adds [tool.sc-lint].setup.pre to ScLintConfigFile; just setup runs the configured argv before provisioning, shown by a stub-command ordering test.
fail: Keeps rejecting [tool.sc-lint].setup with config.unknown_table, so consumers still need Justfile glue before just setup.

history.previous_statement: The consumer sc-lint config must accept setup.pre, an argv list that just setup runs before sc-lint provisioning.

anchors.statement: The [tool.sc-lint] consumer config must accept runner.python, a venv path whose interpreter replaces a leading python in each lint and test step argv on Linux, macOS and Windows.
anchors.quote: these are the p1 items from atm-core: - randlee/sc-lint#198 (consumer setup hook and step runner): atm-core keeps _py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix and _sc-lint-clippy until it ships.
anchors.context: Phase M planning session; atm-core P1 list pasted by Rand; proposal text from sc-lint#198 and atm-core comment 2026-10-29 item 2. CONFLICT: ADR-020 decisions 9 and 13 (Accepted, Rand 2026-10-27) say runner.python is not added
anchors.summary: A4 #198: consumer runner.python (CONDITIONAL on a new ADR superseding ADR-020 decisions 9/13 and REQ-CLI-021 (clint drafting, Rand approving).)
anchors.scope: The item edits ScLintConfigFile or consumer config parsing, lint/test step argv construction in crates/sc-lint, or venv interpreter path resolution (bin/python vs Scripts\python.exe).
anchors.deterministic_check: Deterministic argv-rewrite unit tests over Unix and Windows venv path forms (bin/python, Scripts\python.exe) with injected platform, no real interpreter.

pass: Adds runner.python; a step argv starting with python runs the venv's bin/python on Unix and Scripts\python.exe on Windows, covered by injected-platform tests.
fail: Runs a step's leading python from PATH regardless of the configured runner.python venv.

history.previous_statement: The consumer sc-lint config must accept runner.python, a venv path whose interpreter replaces a leading python in each lint and test step argv on Linux, macOS and Windows.

anchors.statement: A consumer step must run a wheel-only sc_lint.<module> helper on the sc-lint kit's own interpreter without the consumer writing a per-OS interpreter path.
anchors.quote: these are the p1 items from atm-core: - randlee/sc-lint#198 (consumer setup hook and step runner): atm-core keeps _py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix and _sc-lint-clippy until it ships.
anchors.context: Phase M planning session; atm-core P1 list pasted by Rand; need stated in atm-core comment on sc-lint#198 2026-10-29 item 1 (no step form to run a wheel-only module on the kit interpreter). Design undecided; awaits atm-core input
anchors.summary: A5 #198: wheel-only sc_lint helpers on the kit interpreter (CONDITIONAL on a new ADR superseding ADR-020 decisions 9/13 and REQ-CLI-021 (clint drafting, Rand approving). Design also awaits atm-core input.)
anchors.scope: The item adds a step kind or subcommand for running sc_lint modules, edits consumer step execution in crates/sc-lint, or documents invoking .sc-lint/venv helpers.
anchors.deterministic_check: A runner test with a stub kit interpreter on Unix and Windows path forms shows a module step resolves to the kit venv interpreter; consumer config for it contains no OS-specific path.

pass: Adds a module step kind so {"module": "sc_lint.lint_cargo_deny"} runs on the kit venv interpreter on every OS.
fail: Documents that consumers must call .sc-lint/venv/bin/python or Scripts\python.exe themselves for each OS.

history.previous_statement: A consumer lint or test step must be able to run a wheel-only sc_lint.<module> helper (lint_cargo_deny, lint_cargo_shear, lint_manifests, lint_codespell) on the sc-lint kit's own interpreter without the consumer writing a per-OS interpreter path.

anchors.context: Phase M planning session; atm-core P1 list pasted by Rand; repro from atm-core comment on sc-lint#136 2026-10-29 (eight SCB-MANIFEST-004 findings on 0.8.2)
anchors.scope: The item edits global_dependency_ownership or SCB-MANIFEST-004 in crates/sc-lint-boundary (manifest_dependency_policy), its config keys, or docs-bundle/packages/sc-lint-boundary.md.

pass: Adds a source-only ownership scope; the #136 repro drops the seven crates/*/tests/ findings and still reports crates/atm/src/commands/mod.rs importing cron.
